findings.description: The proposed schema records base_ref but does not pin a distinct resolved base commit SHA, even though the contract requires a recorded base SHA and default-branch resolution that cannot drift after creation.
findings.recommendation: Add an immutable base_sha field, keep source_ref/base_ref separately, and assert all snapshots and renderers carry the resolved SHA.

findings.description: Create says it resolves the plan dir and uses the repo default branch, but it does not pin the authoritative repo_root source or prove the command cannot accidentally use the invoking checkout's repository.
findings.recommendation: Define how repo_root is derived for a plan, require create to use that repo_root for base resolution and worktree add, and test invocation from an unrelated checkout.

findings.description: Broken-binding detection only mentions missing paths or not-a-git-worktree, but does not require validating that the path is a worktree of the recorded repo_root rather than an arbitrary git repository.
findings.recommendation: Mark bindings broken when the path is not listed as a worktree for the stored repo_root or its git common-dir does not match the recorded repository.

findings.description: The dashboard plan proves payload shape and DOM rendering from a fixture, but does not explicitly wire the real dashboard state producer or local JSON state path to include the active-worktrees block.
findings.recommendation: Add an integration assertion that the actual dashboard state generation path emits the same worktree-status model consumed by the UI.

findings.description: The branch and deterministic worktree path are described as derived from plan_id, but the derivation, sanitization, collision behavior, and existing-branch handling are not pinned.
findings.recommendation: Specify the exact plan_id-to-branch/path algorithm and refusal behavior for collisions with existing branches or occupied deterministic paths.

findings.description: The wrong-worktree guard compares the invoking git toplevel with the bound path, but does not define canonicalization or non-git cwd behavior before side effects.
findings.recommendation: Canonicalize both paths and require a clean refusal when rev-parse fails outside any git worktree.

findings.description: The no-DontPanic-merge-command non-goal is referenced as an assertion in a separate D005 item that is not part of the proposed feature list, leaving the scope guard unowned.
findings.recommendation: Attach the CLI-surface assertion directly to F003 or add an explicit feature/test that proves no merge command is introduced.
